import pandas as pd

# File paths for source data
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_37/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_37/test_1.csv"

# Load source tables
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# Inspect schemas:
# df0 columns: ['business_id', 'Score', 'date', 'type']
# df1 columns: ['business_id', 'date', 'ViolationTypeID', 'risk_category', 'description']

# Transformation plan:
# - Target schema: ['business_id': int, 'Score': float, 'date': int, 'type': str, 'ViolationTypeID': int, 'risk_category': str, 'description': str]
# - Source0 has business_id, Score, date, type but no ViolationTypeID, risk_category, description
# - Source1 has business_id, date, ViolationTypeID, risk_category, description but no Score, type
# - We want to combine these two sources by matching on business_id and date to get all columns in one table.
# - Since Source0 has Score and type, Source1 has ViolationTypeID, risk_category, description, join on ['business_id', 'date'] to combine.
# - Some business_id/date pairs may be missing in either source, so use inner join to keep only matching records (since target examples show all columns present).
# - Convert data types to match target schema.
# - Export the combined dataframe to the target CSV.

# Convert date columns to int if not already
df0['date'] = df0['date'].astype(int)
df1['date'] = df1['date'].astype(int)

# Merge on business_id and date
df_merged = pd.merge(df0, df1, on=['business_id', 'date'], how='inner')

# Ensure columns are in target order and types
df_merged = df_merged[['business_id', 'Score', 'date', 'type', 'ViolationTypeID', 'risk_category', 'description']]

# Convert types explicitly
df_merged['business_id'] = df_merged['business_id'].astype(int)
df_merged['Score'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['Score'], errors='coerce')  # Score is float, NaNs allowed
df_merged['date'] = df_merged['date'].astype(int)
df_merged['type'] = df_merged['type'].astype(str)
df_merged['ViolationTypeID'] = df_merged['ViolationTypeID'].astype(int)
df_merged['risk_category'] = df_merged['risk_category'].astype(str)
df_merged['description'] = df_merged['description'].astype(str)

# Write to target CSV
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_37/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_merged.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
